Package it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.controller

Class ChefController

java.lang.Object
it.unipi.MySmartRecipeBook.controller.ChefController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/chefs") @PreAuthorize("hasRole(\'CHEF\')") public class ChefController extends Object
REST Controller for managing Chef profiles and their recipe operations.

      @PostMapping("/changeInfo") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<RegisteredUserInfoDTO> updateInformation(@Valid @RequestBody @Valid UpdateChefDTO updates)
